description: This file contains XML definitions of services related to shipment picklist management in the OFBiz framework. The services include functions for finding orders to pick, creating picklists, printing pick sheets, editing picklist items, and generating reports. The content includes detailed logic for order filtering, grouping, and inventory reservation processes, indicating it is a configuration or service definition file rather than executable code.

methods.name: findOrdersToPickMove
methods.description: Finds orders ready to be picked or needing stock moves based on specified filters and grouping criteria.

methods.name: assembleOrderHeaderInfoInline
methods.description: Assembles detailed order and inventory info for orders identified for picking, including reservations and stock levels.

methods.name: createPicklistFromOrders
methods.description: Creates a picklist from the selected orders and prepares picklist bins and items.

methods.name: printPickSheets
methods.description: Generates pick sheets for orders, with options to filter by group and order count.

methods.name: editPicklistItem
methods.description: Allows editing a picklist item to link it to a specific lot and update quantities.

methods.name: setPicklistItemToComplete
methods.description: Marks a picklist item as completed.

methods.name: getPicklistDisplayInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information for displaying picklists, including pagination.

methods.name: getPicklistSingleInfoInline
methods.description: Creates a detailed map of picklist info, including roles, statuses, bins, and items, for a specific picklist.

methods.name: getPickAndPackReportInfo
methods.description: Assembles comprehensive picklist report data, including facility location info and product info, for printing pick sheets and packing.

methods.name: checkPicklistBinItemStatuses
methods.description: Checks the status of items within a picklist bin and updates the overall picklist status accordingly to cancelled or completed.

methods.name: cancelPicklistAndItems
methods.description: Cancels all picklist items associated with a specific picklist and updates their status to cancelled.
